summary.content:
Today's selection covers 51 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Yahoo CEO Jim Lanzone on reviving the web’s homepage
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Attackers Abuse LiveChat to Phish Credit Card, Personal Data
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 20 articles published in the last 24 hours
